Yoma III, 40ᵈ</cite> top <he>ואין שני שבפילוסין … משם מילה דשמעה פ׳</he> is not second class Pelusium linen better than first class Indian? but (the latter is preferred) because of the thing which is named ‘first.’ <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:6:9">Ib.</cite> (as regards oil, ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:5">Men. VIII, 5</cite>).
